title: 第153章 默契挑战
slug: 综艺大导演从齐聚初代跑男开始
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

两人对视了片刻后，邓朝率先开口说话。

邓朝脸上堆满了笑，语气热情得像见了亲兄弟似的，“洪雷哥！欢迎欢迎！好久不见又变帅了！”

孙洪雷也不甘示弱，一把搂住邓朝的肩膀，笑得眼睛都眯成了一条缝：“你也很帅啊，这西装穿得，啧啧啧，跟个真总裁似的！”

“什么总裁啊。”邓朝谦虚道，“还是你更有气质。”

“看你这话说的！”孙洪雷拍了拍他的背，“我只是占了一个帅，气质都是你的。”

两个人说完大笑起来，然后紧紧拥抱在一起。

亲热得像是失散多年的兄弟。

但如果有慢镜头回放，你会发现。

他们拥抱的时候，邓朝眼睛往左边瞥了一眼。

在打量着四周的情况。

孙洪雷也是如此。

邓朝双手插兜，笑着道：“洪雷哥，今天咱们是对手吧。”

孙洪雷把西装外套往肩上一甩，无所谓道：“什么对手不对手的，都是朋友！当然朋友之间，偶尔分个高下也很正常的。”

两个人对视一秒，然后同时笑了起来。

邓朝点点头，环顾了一下四周道：“先看看现在要做什么吧，还不知道其他人都在哪呢。”

他说的没错。

大厅里空空荡荡，刚才还站在这里的其他成员，此刻全都不见了踪影。

两个人往前走了几步，来到一条走廊的入口。

走廊很长，一眼望不到头。

两边是一扇扇紧闭的房间门。

门牌号从201到214，整齐排列。

走廊铺着暗红色的地毯，墙壁上挂着油画。

每隔几步就有一盏壁灯，光线昏黄而暧昧。

整条走廊安静得只能听见他们两个人的脚步声。

而他们站的位置，恰恰是走廊的最尽头。

也就是说想要离开，就必须从这条走廊一直走到头。

邓朝看着两边紧闭的房门，脑子里飞快地转着，说道：“洪雷哥，你说其他人会不会就在这些房间里？”

孙洪雷侧耳听了听，然后摇了摇头：“不知道啊，一点动静都没有。”

然后两个人同时往走廊深处走了几步。

就在这时候。

吴凡的声音从天花板上方的音响中传了出来：

“两位队长，欢迎来到安氏集团的继承者考验。”

邓朝和孙洪雷同时停下脚步，仰头看向天花板。

“你们现在需要做的第一件事，就是集合自己的伙伴。团队的力量远大于个人之和，可以完成许多个人难以做到的事情，俗话说人心齐，泰山移！”

吴凡的声音不紧不慢，“而一个团队最重要的又是默契，伙伴之间无需过多言语就能读懂彼此心意，能相互补位，从而凝聚起前行的力量。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

After the two looked at each other for a moment, Deng Chao spoke first.

Deng Chao's face was full of smiles, and his tone was as warm as if he had met his own brother, "Brother Hong Lei! Welcome! He's handsome again after a long time!"

Not to be outdone, Sun Honglei hugged Deng Chao's shoulders and smiled so hard that his eyes narrowed into slits: "You are also very handsome. You look like a real CEO in this suit!"

"What kind of CEO?" Deng Chao said modestly, "You are more elegant."

"Look at what you said!" Sun Honglei patted him on the back, "I just took advantage of him, and the temperament is all yours."

The two laughed and hugged each other tightly.

As affectionate as a long-lost brother.

But if there is slow motion playback, you will find it.

As they hugged, Deng glanced to the left.

Looking at the surrounding situation.

The same is true for Sun Honglei.

Deng Chao put his hands in his pockets and said with a smile: "Brother Hong Lei, we must be opponents today."

Sun Honglei threw his suit jacket over his shoulders and said nonchalantly: "Those who are rivals or not are all friends! Of course, it is normal for friends to have differences from time to time."

The two looked at each other for a second, then laughed at the same time.

Deng Chao nodded, looked around and said, "Let's see what we have to do now. I don't know where everyone else is yet."

He's right.

The hall was empty, and the other members who were standing here just now were all gone.

The two people walked a few steps forward and came to the entrance of a corridor.

The corridor is so long that you can't see the end at a glance.

On both sides are closed room doors.

The house numbers are from 201 to 214, arranged neatly.

The corridor is paved with dark red carpet and oil paintings are hung on the walls.

There is a wall lamp every few steps, and the light is dim and ambiguous.

The entire corridor was so quiet that only their footsteps could be heard.

And where they were standing was exactly at the end of the corridor.

In other words, if you want to leave, you must walk all the way from this corridor to the end.

Deng Chao looked at the closed doors on both sides, his mind spinning rapidly, and said, "Brother Hong Lei, do you think other people are in these rooms?"

Sun Honglei listened carefully, then shook his head: "I don't know, there is no movement at all."

Then the two of them took a few steps deeper into the corridor at the same time.

That's when.

Wu Fan's voice came from the speaker above the ceiling:

"Two captains, welcome to the test of the successor of the An Group."

Deng Chao and Sun Honglei stopped at the same time and looked up at the ceiling.

"The first thing you need to do now is to gather your partners. The power of a team is far greater than the sum of individuals, and it can accomplish many things that are difficult for individuals. As the saying goes, if we unite with our hearts, we can move mountains!"

Wu Fan's voice was unhurried, "The most important thing for a team is tacit understanding. Partners can understand each other's thoughts without too many words and can complement each other's positions, thus gathering the strength to move forward."
